call_points.text: No Nazara-level revenue, EBITDA or margin guidance for FY27.
Bluetile and BestPlay reported ₹518 Cr revenue and ₹55 Cr EBITDA in Q1FY27; consolidation expected from Q2FY27.
Raymond Stauffer, Bluetile founder-CEO, becomes Nazara CEO from 1 September 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.
NODWIN targets organic growth of 30%+ for FY27 and is progressing towards IPO readiness.
Sportskeeda's Google-related challenges persist; management sees Q1 as the bottom with revenue rising through Q2-Q4.
AdTech EBITDA stays thin because pass-through revenue is 60-80% of reported topline; margin improvement tied to Vizibl.
Tax exposure from real-money gaming subsidiaries is limited to the investments, which have been fully written off.
No numeric FY27 guidance; management expects both organic revenue growth and margin expansion, citing Centers of Excellence and AI.
Curve Games expects at least 6 new releases this year; Wax Heads released last week, Sovereign Tower and Dragon Shelter in summer.
NODWIN plans to raise $100-200 million, primary and secondary, and prepare for an IPO; Nazara may monetise non-core assets in FY27-FY28.
Kiddopia returned to subscriber growth in Q3 and sustained it in Q4, helped by four IP integrations and better paid efficiency.
Adtech revenue declined sequentially as the company shifted focus to its DSP product; UK new-homes market weakness hit Space and Time.
Fusebox plans to expand Big Brother from one season to three in FY27 and launch Traitors, plus three Love Island seasons.

operating_notes.text: Gaming EBITDA was ₹265 Cr in FY26 at a 24.7% margin, and gaming's share of EBITDA rose from 56% to 90%.
Bluetile's CY25 revenue was about ₹1,460 Cr with ₹254 Cr EBITDA; consolidation expected from Q1FY27 after Spanish FDI approval.
Human Fall Flat crossed 58 million lifetime units globally; NODWIN moved from a ₹14 Cr loss in FY25 to a ₹21 Cr profit in FY26.
Bluetile and BestPlay reported ₹518 Cr revenue and ₹55 Cr EBITDA in Q1FY27, with revenue up 54% YoY and UA spend at 85% of revenue.
PC and Console publishing posted ₹53 Cr revenue and ₹14 Cr EBITDA (27% margin) in Q1FY27; Human: Fall Flat has sold 60 million units cumulatively.
Datawrkz pass-through revenue represents 60-80% of reported AdTech topline, limiting EBITDA conversion.
